|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Trade Federation Tactics (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The image here is the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-28E-Trade_Federation_Tactics.png]]), which shows this text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-tradefederationtactics-pre.gif]], marked E) shows the PC-E1 text (see [[Trade Federation Tactics (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip [[:File:VB5-28E-Trade_Federation_Tactics.png]], a Used or Lost Interrupt): “USED: For remainder of turn, if your starship is about to be hit (or lost), that action may instead affect your character aboard that starship. LOST: If your [Episode I] character is about to be hit (or lost), that action instead affects your other [Episode I] character present.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Trade Federation Tactics (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): rewritten as a Used Interrupt: “Retarget an attempt to make your [Episode I] character 'hit' or lost to your other [Episode I] character present. OR Retarget opponent's just drawn destiny result about to make your starship 'hit' or lost to your character aboard; starship is protected from all such attempts this turn. OR ▼ Sil Unch.” Shown on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), which writes the ▼ out as “deploy Sil Unch”<ref name="cl-1250_28-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>; also in Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata)<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-22; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> and in the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>.
